review_mode: independent read-only replay of frozen source and sealed native raw evidence
reviewer: separate review agent; no file edits and no SIMLOX invocation
limits: The event log adds and removes one base backorder at hour 10; report NBO=0 is zero-duration occupancy, not absence of a backorder event.
This run does not establish a general same-time event priority rule.
StockTotalResults is aggregate; station-specific stock identities and absence of an active terminal shipment come from the complete event log.
The native event log rounds fractional-hour timestamps.
The runner verifies GUI process identity and active session; GUI visual content was not sampled.
The author validator was added after the native run and is a read-only replay, not an invocation-hashed prelaunch source.
